ui_bugs.component: VisualsPage — Home BG section + Login BG section
ui_bugs.issue: Duplicate data-testid: both the inner ImageControl reset button (slug='homebg' -> 'visuals-homebg-reset') and the outer section-wide reset button share the same testid 'visuals-homebg-reset' (count=2). Same collision exists for 'visuals-loginbg-reset' (count=2). Any test/automation using [data-testid='visuals-homebg-reset'] hits the FIRST match (ImageControl) which only resets the URL field, NOT the enabled/opacity/fit/blur. This breaks the advertised reset flow via that selector.

action_items: Rename outer reset buttons to distinct testids to avoid duplicates with ImageControl's inner reset. Suggested: 'visuals-homebg-reset-all' / 'visuals-loginbg-reset-all' (or change ImageControl's reset id to 'visuals-<slug>-reset-image'). This aligns with the FROZEN spec that expects a single deterministic testid for the section-level reset.

Pre-existing baseline drift: /api/settings/public currently shows dashboard_bg_enabled=true (url=/api/media/d4746342-..., opacity=24, fit=cover, blur=0) and login_bg_enabled=true (url=/api/media/144b8edf-..., opacity=24, fit=cover, blur=0). These were NOT touched by this iteration but the spec's freeze requires them at defaults (enabled=false, url='', opacity=10, fit=cover, blur=0). Please decide: restore or accept as intentional CMS content.

rca of the issue: Duplicate data-testid bug RCA: ImageControl (line 161 in VisualsPage.tsx) sets its reset button testid to `visuals-${slug}-reset`; when the parent BgAppearance/section uses the SAME slug ('homebg' or 'loginbg') for its section-level reset button (lines 495, 535), both buttons carry identical testids. Reproduction: on /admin/visuals, `document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="visuals-homebg-reset"]').length === 2`. Mitigation: change the section-level outer button testid to something distinct (e.g., 'visuals-homebg-reset-all') OR change ImageControl's reset id to 'visuals-<slug>-reset-image'. Confirmed both fields (home_bg_* / login_bg_*) affected; dashboard uses distinct 'visuals-dashboard-reset-marble' and is unaffected.
